department: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics, Physics or Psychology Subject Tests are optional.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Mathematics, Physics, or Psychology Subject Tests: Optional

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional.

supervisor.value: Your first year is GSAS-funded so you can explore before choosing a PhD advisor; you name faculty of interest in the application.
supervisor.quote: This system is set up so the student can explore the scientific possibilities within the department before deciding upon a dissertation topic and PhD advisor.

also.quote: Applicants should indicate the faculty whose research fields are closest to their interests in the faculty section of the application for admission.

funding.value: All Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD students get guaranteed funding for the first five years.
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from a recognized institution is accepted.
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)
